name: Flourless Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: fine instant espresso powder, such as Delallo
unsweetened cocoa powder, plus more for dusting

instructions.primary_message: Finely chop the bittersweet chocolate. Cube the unsalted butter. Sift the unsweetened cocoa powder. Bring the eggs to room temperature.
instructions.secondary_message:
113 g bittersweet chocolate, 60% cacao
113 g unsalted butter
46 g unsweetened cocoa powder, plus more for dusting
3 large eggs

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) (175ºC). Using baking spray, coat the interior of a 23-cm springform pan; line bottom of pan with a parchment paper round and the sides with a separate parchment strip; set aside.

Fill a medium saucepan with water to a depth of 2.5 cm and bring to a boil over medium-high; reduce heat to a simmer over medium-low. In a medium-size heatproof bowl, combine chocolate, butter, espresso powder, and salt, and place over saucepan of simmering water. Cook, stirring frequently, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat, being careful not to drip any water into the melted chocolate. Whisk in cocoa powder and vanilla extract until combined and smooth; set aside.

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine eggs and sugar. Whisk on medium-high speed until mixture is pale, falls off the whisk attachment in thick ribbons (they should slowly sink back into the batter) and has increased by about 1/3 in volume, 5 to 7 minutes. (Alternatively, an electric hand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment can be used to whip the eggs and sugar.) Using a flexible spatula, fold chocolate mixture into eggs gradually until just combined and no streaks remain. Gently scrape chocolate batter into prepared pan, using a small offset spatula to evenly spread and smooth the top if necessary.

Bake until top is dry and a wooden toothpick inserted near center of cake comes out with a few moist crumbs, about 25 minutes. Let cool in pan on a wire rack for 30 minutes. Run a small offset spatula or butter knife around edges of cake to loosen, if necessary; remove pan sides, and discard strips of parchment. Let cake cool completely on pan base on wire rack, about 1 1/2 hours. Using a large offset spatula, gently loosen cake from pan base and carefully transfer cake to a plate, removing and discarding parchment round. Using a fine-mesh sieve, dust cake with additional cocoa powder. Serve with sweetened whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, if desired.

description: Rich and pleasantly bittersweet with crisp edges and a fudgy interior, this flourless chocolate cake will keep you coming back for more.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 3 hr.

Optional or for serving: Sweetened whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, for serving (optional)

Notes: To make this cake gluten-free, skip the baking spray with flour. Brush cake pan with softened unsalted butter, then dust with cornstarch or your gluten-free flour blend of choice, shaking out excess.
The cake can also be dusted with confectioners’ sugar.

Make-ahead and storage: Once cooled, the cake can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days or refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 1 week.The cake can be tightly wrapped in plastic and frozen for up to 1 month. To thaw, let sit in refrigerator overnight.
author: Genevieve Yam
